analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md: the 'Last updated' stamp (line 3) and a 3-line addition near head lines 985-987 describing landing-site test coverage (browser/RSC 404s, explicit and negotiated Markdown, agent discovery links, and their absence from human navigation and the XML sitemap). I reviewed the supplied base text units (lines 477-1217), which include the surrounding landing-test section, and the patch excerpt, which is marked complete. The change is documentation only. It adds no code, no runtime behavior, no credentials or secrets, no endpoint or deployment change, and no alteration to the TB-002/TB-003/TB-007/TB-011 boundaries, attestation, App Attest authorization (T-053), or the encrypted prefix cache (T-041). The added text describes test coverage for the public landing site, which is outside the provider threat model's in-scope components. I found no invalidated assumptions and no mitigation weakened. The landing tests, the discovery-link implementation and the sitemap behavior are not in the supplied evidence, so the doc's accuracy about them is unverified. That is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security regression. No integration questions remain for the provider security model.
